name: Black Blade Adept (Legendary Arcanist Archetype)
body:
Like many magi, there are legendary arcanists who come into possession of a black blade, a sentient weapon bound to serve the adept.

Hit Dice: The black blade adept uses d8 to determine their hit points.
Base Attack Bonus: The black blade adept has a base attack bonus equal to a magus of equal level. This replaces arcane surge.
Class Features
Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

The black blade adept is proficient with all simple and martial weapons.

This modifies weapon and armor proficiency.

Black Blade (Ex)

At 3rd level, the black blade adept gains a black blade as a bladebound magus, using their class level as their magus level and using their arcane reservoir in place of their arcane pool.

A black blade adept cannot have a familiar of any kind, even from another class.

This replaces the exploits gained at 2nd, 8th, and 14th level.

Fighter Training (Ex)

At 8th level, the black blade adept counts 1/2 their class level as their fighter level for the purpose of qualifying for feats. If they have levels in fighter, these levels stack.

Arcanist Exploits

A black blade adept can select from the following additional exploits.

Close Range (Ex)

The black blade adept can deliver legendary arcanist ray spells that feature a ranged touch attack as melee touch spells. If the spell normally targets multiple targets (such as scorching ray), only one target is affected; additional touch attacks from that spell are wasted and have no effect. These spells can be used with the spellstrike exploit.

Spell Strike (Su)

The black blade adept can deliver touch spells with a melee weapon they are proficient with. This works as the magus ability of the same name.

Greater Exploits

A black blade adept can choose from the following additional greater exploits:

Eldritch Blade (Ex)

A blade adept with this exploit uses their caster level instead of their class level for the purpose of advancing their bonded sword’s powers.

Hasted Assault (Su)

The black blade adept can expend 1 point from their arcane reservoir as a swift action to move more quickly.

This functions as haste, but only targets the black blade adept and lasts for a number of rounds equal to their Charisma bonus.

Legendary Arcanists, © 2024, Legendary Games; Author: Andrew J. Gibson.
